_frozen: 2026-10-05, True, for Air's status-line bench. Each proposition says what its canonical line already entails and nothing more: no new facts, causes, destinations, history, people or advice. The canonical line is kept beside it; the proposition is a parallel human-facing field, not a rewrite of canon.

1.canonical: Authentic expression — the function is operating correctly, present-centered, integrated.
1.plain: You are doing this now, it is working, and it is part of you. Nothing about it needs fixing.

2.canonical: Over-expressing — anxiety, control, pushing ahead of natural timing.
2.plain: You are doing more of this than the situation needs right now. You are pushing ahead of where things actually are, and it shows up as worry, or as trying to control how things turn out.

3.canonical: Under-expressing — withdrawn, avoidant, not fully arriving in the present.
3.plain: You are doing less of this than the situation needs right now. You have pulled back from it, and part of you is still with how things were instead of how they are.

4.canonical: Acting now, but not as the author — the doing is the person's own and they are not holding it as theirs.
4.plain: You are doing this, right now, and you do not see it as your own doing. It is yours, and you are not treating it as yours.

readability-2026-10-05-B-1.canonical: You are living by a pattern you built and calling it the way things are.
readability-2026-10-05-B-1.plain: You made the way you see this, and you treat that way of seeing as simply how things are.

readability-2026-10-05-B-2.canonical: Radiance flows from genuine development — shining because what was cultivated reached completion
readability-2026-10-05-B-2.plain: What you are giving off now comes from something you grew over time and brought to completion.

readability-2026-10-05-B-9.canonical: Spiritual sleep — refusing the call, perpetual seeking that never lands
readability-2026-10-05-B-9.plain: You are not answering something that is calling for your attention, and you keep searching without ever letting the search arrive anywhere.
